title: Gap Fill by Direction
summary: The gap-fill rate with up-gaps and down-gaps side by side. Each row's denominator is the sessions that gapped that way (roll days excluded by construction); the numerator is the ones that traded back to the prior session's close during the session. Up/down asymmetry is the whole question here, so compare the two rows' confidence intervals rather than their point estimates alone.

params.name: minGapPct
params.doc: Only gaps at least this large (percent of prior close, absolute).

deltas: both directions in one result, each with its own N and 95% CI
a size floor keeps micro-gaps from diluting the comparison
any further condition: weekday, events, volatility regime: applies to both rows at once
